name: mattdemarillac/oobj-search
description: Out Of Body Search: product search that understands price, material, fitting, gauge, colour and placement in plain words.

scripts-descriptions.test: PHPUnit tests, in the litespeed container of the local stack (args go to PHPUnit, e.g. -- --filter Search).
scripts-descriptions.lint: Check PHP against the WordPress Coding Standards (phpcs.xml.dist).
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Fix what phpcbf can fix automatically.
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: PHPUnit with code coverage (PCOV, built once into tests/coverage/); fails below 100% of lines. HTML report in tests/coverage/html/.
scripts-descriptions.test:query: The query reader, vocabulary and product facts (inc/query/, plain PHP), without WordPress: on the host, in seconds.
